#  1A. calculate the diversity of incorporators/non incorporators
```{r calc_div}
library(picante)

shrubs <- colnames(ft.t.inc)   # samples with EAF data
taxa   <- rownames(ft.t.pa)

#. EAF aligned to ft.t.pa rows; NA or missing = 0
eaf <- matrix(0, nrow = length(taxa), ncol = length(shrubs),
              dimnames = list(taxa, shrubs))
shared <- intersect(taxa, rownames(ft.t.inc))
eaf[shared, ] <- as.matrix(ft.t.inc[shared, shrubs])
eaf[is.na(eaf)] <- 0
setdiff(rownames(ft.t.inc), taxa)   # should be empty

#. presence in each sample's NH4 incubation (heavy t4 or light t5)
pres <- sapply(shrubs, function(s) {
  cols <- paste0(s, c("t4", "t5"))
  as.integer(rowSums(ft.t.pa[, cols, drop = FALSE] > 0) > 0)
})
rownames(pres) <- taxa

#. per-sample classification
inc.m <- (eaf > 0) * 1L                 # incorporators in that sample
all.m <- ((pres + inc.m) > 0) * 1L      # all taxa in that sample
ni.m  <- all.m * (1L - inc.m)           # present but not incorporating there

#. richness
rich <- data.frame(total_richness = colSums(all.m),
                   i_richness     = colSums(inc.m),
                   ni_richness    = colSums(ni.m))

#. Faith's PD: one pd() call on all three community sets
comm <- rbind(t(all.m), t(inc.m), t(ni.m))
rownames(comm) <- c(paste0(shrubs, "_all"), paste0(shrubs, "_inc"), paste0(shrubs, "_ni"))
comm <- comm[, colnames(comm) %in% tree$tip.label, drop = FALSE]
tree.p <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, colnames(comm)))
pds <- pd(comm, tree.p, include.root = TRUE)

#. combine
div <- data.frame(
  sample         = shrubs,
  site           = substr(shrubs, 1, 2),
  rich[shrubs, ],
  total_fpd      = pds[paste0(shrubs, "_all"), "PD"],
  i_fpd          = pds[paste0(shrubs, "_inc"), "PD"],
  ni_fpd         = pds[paste0(shrubs, "_ni"),  "PD"],
  row.names = NULL
)

div
```
#  1B. run model and make table s5
```{r table_s5}
dat.A <- div
dat.A$Site <- factor(c(PB = "Low", WC = "Mid", MC = "High")[dat.A$site],
                     levels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))

responses <- c("N-assimilator richness"   = "i_richness",
               "N-assimilator FPD"        = "i_fpd",
               "Non-assimilator richness" = "ni_richness",
               "Non-assimilator FPD"      = "ni_fpd")

#. contrasts in table order (first - second)
comps <- list(c("Mid", "High"), c("Low", "High"), c("Low", "Mid"))

tab5 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(responses), function(nm) {

  m  <- aov(as.formula(paste(responses[nm], "~ Site")), data = dat.A)
  a  <- anova(m)
  tk <- TukeyHSD(m, "Site")$Site

  #. Tukey md and p, flipping sign if R lists the pair the other way
  tk.out <- unlist(lapply(comps, function(x) {
    ab <- paste0(x[1], "-", x[2]); ba <- paste0(x[2], "-", x[1])
    if (ab %in% rownames(tk)) c(md =  tk[ab, "diff"], p = tk[ab, "p adj"])
    else                      c(md = -tk[ba, "diff"], p = tk[ba, "p adj"])
  }))
  names(tk.out) <- paste(rep(sapply(comps, paste, collapse = "-"), each = 2),
                         c("md", "p"), sep = "_")

  data.frame(Response = nm,
             F    = round(a["Site", "F value"], 2),
             p    = round(a["Site", "Pr(>F)"], 3),
             n.df = a["Site", "Df"],
             d.df = a["Residuals", "Df"],
             t(round(tk.out, 3)),
             check.names = FALSE)
}))

```

# 2A. calculate richness of total bacterial community and add 16S data
```{r calc_total_div}
#  add rows for light incubation to metadata for diversity modeling
t4 <- sc.d[sc.d$Treatment == "NH4", ]
t4$MCSID      <- sub("t5$", "t4", t4$MCSID)
t4$Incubation <- "t4"
t4[, !(colnames(t4) %in% c("MCSID", "Incubation", "Treatment", "Shrub", "Site"))] <- NA
rownames(t4) <- NULL
sc.d <- rbind(sc.d, t4)

#. aggregate 16S qPCR data add to MD
qpcr <- tapply(md$copies.ul, md$incubation, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
sc.d$qpcr <- qpcr[match(sc.d$MCSID, names(qpcr))]
rm(t4,qpcr)

#. create additional presence-absence datasets so we have all observed taxa (ft.t.pa) and and non-incorporators (ft.t.pa.2)
ft.t.pa.2 <- ft.t.pa[!(row.names(ft.t.pa)%in%row.names(ft.t.inc)),]

#. take the presence/absence data from the column sums and add to MD
rich<-colSums(ft.t.pa)
sc.d$total_richness <- rich[match(sc.d$MCSID, names(rich))]
rich<-colSums(ft.t.pa.2)
sc.d$ni_richness <- rich[match(sc.d$MCSID, names(rich))]

#. calculate faith's PD
## Faith's PD (ASV-level, using tree)
asv_comm <- t((ft.t.pa > 0) * 1L)   # samples x taxa
common_asv <- intersect(colnames(asv_comm), tree$tip.label)
asv_comm_pd <- asv_comm[, common_asv, drop = FALSE]
tree_asv_pd <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, common_asv))
PD_ASV_vec <- pd(asv_comm_pd, tree_asv_pd, include.root = TRUE)$PD
names(PD_ASV_vec) <- rownames(asv_comm_pd)  # sample names
sc.d$total_fpd <- PD_ASV_vec[match(sc.d$MCSID, names(PD_ASV_vec))]

asv_comm <- t((ft.t.pa.2 > 0) * 1L)   # samples x taxa
common_asv <- intersect(colnames(asv_comm), tree$tip.label)
asv_comm_pd <- asv_comm[, common_asv, drop = FALSE]
tree_asv_pd <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, common_asv))
PD_ASV_vec <- pd(asv_comm_pd, tree_asv_pd, include.root = TRUE)$PD
names(PD_ASV_vec) <- rownames(asv_comm_pd)  # sample names
sc.d$ni_fpd <- PD_ASV_vec[match(sc.d$MCSID, names(PD_ASV_vec))]

rm(asv_comm,common_asv,tree_asv_pd,PD_ASV_vec,qpcr,rich,rng)

#. for the NH4 incubations, subtract pre treatment to make it a delta like the other values
sc.d.2<- sc.d #. no differences calculated 

sc.d[25:36,]$qpcr <- (sc.d[25:36,]$qpcr - sc.d[1:12,]$qpcr)
sc.d[25:36,]$total_richness <- (sc.d[25:36,]$total_richness - sc.d[1:12,]$total_richness)
sc.d[25:36,]$total_fpd <- (sc.d[25:36,]$total_fpd - sc.d[1:12,]$total_fpd)
sc.d[25:36,]$ni_richness <- (sc.d[25:36,]$ni_richness - sc.d[1:12,]$ni_richness)
sc.d[25:36,]$ni_fpd <- (sc.d[25:36,]$ni_fpd - sc.d[1:12,]$ni_fpd)
sc.d[25:36,]$i_richness <- (sc.d[25:36,]$i_richness - sc.d[1:12,]$i_richness)
```

# 2B. run model and make table s6
```{r table_s6}
#. raw values (sc.d.2), not deltas, since Dry is a level in the model
dat.B <- sc.d.2
dat.B$Treatment <- factor(c(tp = "Dry", t5 = "14NH4", t4 = "15NH4")[dat.B$Incubation],
                          levels = c("Dry", "14NH4", "15NH4"))
dat.B$Site <- factor(c(PB = "Low", WC = "Mid", MC = "High")[dat.B$Site],
                     levels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))
dat.B <- droplevels(subset(dat.B, !is.na(Treatment)))

responses <- c("16S gene copies" = "qpcr",
               "Total richness"  = "total_richness",
               "Total FPD"       = "total_fpd")

#. contrasts in table order (first - second)
comps <- list(c("15NH4", "Dry"))

tab6 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(responses), function(nm) {

  m  <- aov(as.formula(paste(responses[nm], "~ Treatment * Site")), data = dat.B)
  a  <- anova(m)
  tk <- TukeyHSD(m, "Treatment")$Treatment

  #. Tukey md and p, flipping sign if R lists the pair the other way
  tk.out <- unlist(lapply(comps, function(x) {
    ab <- paste0(x[1], "-", x[2]); ba <- paste0(x[2], "-", x[1])
    if (ab %in% rownames(tk)) c(md =  tk[ab, "diff"], p = tk[ab, "p adj"])
    else                      c(md = -tk[ba, "diff"], p = tk[ba, "p adj"])
  }))
  names(tk.out) <- paste(rep(sapply(comps, paste, collapse = "-"), each = 2),
                         c("md", "p"), sep = "_")

  data.frame(Response    = nm,
             Trt_F       = round(a["Treatment", "F value"], 2),
             Trt_p       = round(a["Treatment", "Pr(>F)"], 3),
             Trt_n.df    = a["Treatment", "Df"],
             TrtSite_F   = round(a["Treatment:Site", "F value"], 2),
             TrtSite_p   = round(a["Treatment:Site", "Pr(>F)"], 3),
             TrtSite_n.df = a["Treatment:Site", "Df"],
             d.df        = a["Residuals", "Df"],
             t(round(tk.out, 3)),
             check.names = FALSE)
}))

```

# 4. model richness against edaphic data

## 4A modeling incorporator richness against dry soil parameters
```{r model_richness, include=FALSE}
# add data to inc.env.pre
inc.env.pre$Rich_ASV_inc <- div$i_richness
inc.env.pre$PD_ASV_inc <- div$i_fpd

#  one example model 
model<-lm(Rich_ASV_inc ~ pH_dry, data=inc.env.pre)
anova(model)
standardize_parameters(model)

#  create a table of all models
# Create an empty results table
model_results1 <- data.frame()
# Define responses and predictors
responses <- c("Rich_ASV_inc", "PD_ASV_inc")
predictors <- c("pH_dry", "NO3", "NH4", "MBN", "MBC", "MB_CN_ratio", "nmTC", "nmTN", "nmT_CN_ratio")
# Loop over responses and predictors
for (resp in responses) {
  row <- list(Response = resp)
  for (pred in predictors) {
    # Construct model formula
    formula <- as.formula(paste(resp, "~", pred))
    # Fit model, handle small sample errors
    model <- tryCatch(lm(formula, data = inc.env.pre), error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(model)) {
      aov_res <- anova(model)
      f_val <- aov_res[1, "F value"]
      p_val <- aov_res[1, "Pr(>F)"]
      std_beta <- tryCatch(standardize_parameters(model)$Std_Coefficient[2], error = function(e) NA)
    } else {
      f_val <- NA
      p_val <- NA
      std_beta <- NA
    }
    
    # Add to row with column names like pH.F, pH.p, pH.beta
    row[[paste0(pred, ".F")]] <- f_val
    row[[paste0(pred, ".p")]] <- p_val
    row[[paste0(pred, ".beta")]] <- std_beta
  }
  model_results1 <- rbind(model_results1, as.data.frame(row))
}

#  clean env
rm(f_val,formula,p_val,pred,predictors,resp, responses,std_beta, row,model)
```
### pH --> richness, MBN --> PD. no other sig relationships. (marginal correlation between MBC and richness)

## 5. plot richness graphs
```{r plot_richness_F3_v2}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

colors<-c("#7698FF", "#18d2ad", "#affb42")

#. make plot function
make_plot <- function(data, x, y) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = {{x}}, y = {{y}})) + 
     geom_jitter(aes(color = Site), width = 0.08, size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
     stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar",
               width = 0.15, color = "black", size = 0.8) +
     stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point",
               shape = 95, size = 10, color = "black") +
     scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
     scale_x_discrete(labels = c("PB" = "Low",
                                "WC" = "Mid",
                                "MC" = "High")) +
    theme_bw() + theme(text = element_text(size = 13), legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank()) 
    }

#. Figure 3B - Inc Richness across Site
B_inc_sr <- make_plot(inc.env.pre, Site, Rich_ASV_inc) + 
  labs(tag = "B") + ylab("") + xlab("") + ylim(50,550)
#. Figure 3E - Inc FPD across Site
E_inc_fpd <- make_plot(inc.env.pre, Site, PD_ASV_inc) + 
  labs(tag = "E") + ylab("") + xlab("") + ylim(2,13) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("PB", "WC"), c("PB", "MC")),
                     method = "t.test", size= 6, label = "p.signif",hide.ns = TRUE,
                     p.adjust.method = "tukey") +
  annotate("text", label="F[2,7]=12.23, p =0.005",  x = Inf, y = Inf,hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3)

#. Figure 3C - Non-Inc Richness across Site
C_N_rewet_ni_sr <- make_plot(sc.d.2[sc.d.2$Incubation=="t5",], Site, ni_richness) + 
  ylab("") + xlab("") + ylim(50,550) + labs(tag = "C")
#. Figure 3F - Non-inc FPD across Site
F_N_rewet_ni_fpd <- make_plot(sc.d.2[sc.d.2$Incubation=="t5",], Site, ni_fpd) + 
  ylab("") + xlab("") + ylim(2,13) + labs(tag = "F") 

#. Figure 3D - change in total richness across sites
D_change_total_sr<-make_plot(sc.d[sc.d$Incubation=="t5",], Site, total_richness) + 
  ylab("") + xlab("")  + labs(tag = "D") 
#. Figure 3G - change in total FPD across sites

  ylab("") + xlab("")  + labs(tag = "G")
```

## 6. calculate average EAF for each taxa at each site
```{r EAF_by_phylum}

colors<-c("#7698FF", "#18d2ad", "#affb42") #PB, WC, MC

library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggforce)

## 1. Melt feature table
ft_long <- melt(as.matrix(ft.t.inc))
colnames(ft_long) <- c("Taxon", "Sample", "EAF")

## 2. Add Site info
site_lookup <- setNames(inc.env.pre$Site, inc.env.pre$Shrub)
ft_long$Site <- site_lookup[as.character(ft_long$Sample)]

## 3. Add Phylum info
phy_lookup <- tt.t$Phylum
names(phy_lookup) <- rownames(tt.t)
ft_long$Phylum <- phy_lookup[as.character(ft_long$Taxon)]

## 4. Clean data: remove NA and zero EAF
ft_long <- ft_long[!is.na(ft_long$EAF) &
                   !is.na(ft_long$Site) &
                   !is.na(ft_long$Phylum) & ft_long$EAF > 0, ]

## Order Site levels and labels for correct colors + spacing
ft_long$Site <- factor(ft_long$Site,
                       levels = c("PB", "WC", "MC"),
                       labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))

## 5. Average EAF per Taxon per Site
ft_mean <- aggregate(EAF ~ Taxon + Site + Phylum, data = ft_long, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
## 5. Transform EAF
ft_mean$logEAF <- log10(ft_mean$EAF)
anova(lm(EAF~Site*Phylum, data=ft_mean))


#  calculate by shrub
ft_mean_2 <- aggregate(EAF ~ Site + Sample + Phylum, data = ft_long, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
anova(lm(EAF~ Phylum * Site, data=ft_mean_2))

## 6. Plot taxon means (each point = a taxon’s mean within that site)
EAF <- ggplot(ft_mean, aes(x = Site, y = EAF, color = Site, fill = Site)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.20, width = 1.0, color = NA) +
    geom_sina(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.25) +

  geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.25, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, name = "Site") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Site") + xlab(" ") +
  theme_bw() + labs(y= "Average Excess Atom Fraction", tag = "A") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
        text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.35)) + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("Low","Mid"), c("Low","High"), c("Mid","High")),
                      method = "t.test", size = 6, label = "p.signif", hide.ns = TRUE,
                      p.adjust.method = "tukey") 
```

```{r fig_2}
# Row titles for the right panel
row_titles <- arrangeGrob(
  textGrob("Species Richness", gp = gpar(fontface = "plain"), rot = 90),
  textGrob("Faith's Phylogenetic Diversity", gp = gpar(fontface = "plain"), rot = 90),
  ncol = 1
)

# 3x2 grid of smaller plots
small_plots <- arrangeGrob(
 B_inc_sr, C_N_rewet_ni_sr, D_change_total_sr, 
 E_inc_fpd, F_N_rewet_ni_fpd, G_change_total_fpd,
  nrow = 2
)

# Right panel: row labels + 2x2 plots
right_panel <- arrangeGrob(
  col_titles,
  arrangeGrob(
    row_titles,
    small_plots,
    ncol = 2,
    widths = c(0.5, 10)
  ),
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 10)
)

# Left panel: EAF plot with no extra decoration
left_panel <- arrangeGrob(EAF)

# Combine left and right
main <- arrangeGrob(
  left_panel,
  right_panel,
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(1, 1.75)   # EAF panel takes 1/3, small plots take 2/3
)

# Add shared x-axis label at bottom
grid.arrange(
  main,
  textGrob("N-deposition and Precipitation", gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")),
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(10, 0.5)
)
```

## 9. Make a tree showing the pagel L and coloring branches by Phylum
```{r fix_tree}

library(ggtree)
library(ggtreeExtra)
library(treeio)
library(tidytree)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggnewscale)
library(ape)
library(phangorn)
library(phytools)
library(cowplot)
library(phytools)

## Make sure tree and feature table are aligned to the same ASVs
common_asv <- intersect(tree$tip.label, rownames(ft.t.inc))
tree_pruned <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, common_asv))
ft.inc      <- ft.t.inc[tree_pruned$tip.label, , drop = FALSE]  # reorder rows to match tree

# 1. Get all Proteobacteria tip labels
proteo_tips <- rownames(tt.t[tt.t$Phylum == "Proteobacteria" & 
                 rownames(tt.t) %in% tree_pruned$tip.label,])

# 2. Find the MRCA node of all Proteobacteria
proteo_mrca <- findMRCA(tree_pruned, proteo_tips)

# 3. Get all descendants of that node
proteo_descendants <- getDescendants(tree_pruned, proteo_mrca)

# 4. Convert node numbers to tip labels (tips have node numbers <= Ntip)
proteo_tip_nodes <- proteo_descendants[proteo_descendants <= Ntip(tree_pruned)]
proteo_clade_tips <- tree_pruned$tip.label[proteo_tip_nodes]

# 5. Find Bacteroidota tips that fall within that clade
misplaced <- rownames(tt.t[tt.t$Phylum == "Bacteroidota" & 
                rownames(tt.t) %in% proteo_clade_tips,])

tt.t[misplaced, "Phylum"] <- "Proteobacteria"  # correct
```

```{r tree}
make_site_tree_phylum_eaf <- function(site_id,
                                      show_legends = TRUE,
                                      bar_pwidth = 0.60,
                                      bar_width  = 0.90) {

  require(ggplot2)
  require(ggtree)
  require(ggtreeExtra)
  require(treeio)
  require(tidytree)
  require(ggnewscale)
  require(ape)
  require(phytools)
  require(scales)

  ## 1) samples for this site
  if (site_id == "ALL") {
    samples_site <- inc.env.pre$Shrub
  } else {
    samples_site <- inc.env.pre$Shrub[inc.env.pre$Site == site_id]
  }
  samples_site <- intersect(samples_site, colnames(ft.inc))
  if (length(samples_site) < 2L) stop("Not enough samples for site ", site_id)

  ## 2) site-mean EAF per taxon
  ft_site  <- ft.inc[, samples_site, drop = FALSE]
  eaf_mean <- rowMeans(ft_site, na.rm = TRUE)
  eaf_mean[is.nan(eaf_mean)] <- NA
  eaf_mean[eaf_mean <= 0] <- NA

  ## 3) keep taxa with EAF and Phylum
  keep_tips <- names(eaf_mean)[!is.na(eaf_mean)]
  keep_tips <- intersect(keep_tips, tree_pruned$tip.label)

  has_phy <- !is.na(tt.t[keep_tips, "Phylum"])
  keep_tips <- keep_tips[has_phy]
  if (length(keep_tips) < 5L) stop("Not enough taxa with EAF+Phylum for site ", site_id)

  ## 4) prune + ladderize
  tree_site <- drop.tip(tree_pruned, setdiff(tree_pruned$tip.label, keep_tips))
  tree_site <- ladderize(tree_site, right = TRUE)

  ## 5) fix tree artifacts
  if (!is.binary(tree_site)) tree_site <- multi2di(tree_site)
  if (is.null(tree_site$edge.length)) tree_site$edge.length <- rep(1, nrow(tree_site$edge))
  if (any(tree_site$edge.length == 0)) tree_site$edge.length[tree_site$edge.length == 0] <- 1e-6

  ## 6) Faith's PD
  faith_pd <- sum(tree_site$edge.length, na.rm = TRUE)

  ## 7) Pagel's lambda
  eaf_tip <- eaf_mean[tree_site$tip.label]
  eaf_tip <- eaf_tip[is.finite(eaf_tip) & !is.na(eaf_tip)]

  trait_var <- stats::var(eaf_tip, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(trait_var) || trait_var == 0) {
    L_res <- list(lambda = NA_real_, P = NA_real_)
  } else {
    L_res <- tryCatch(
      phytools::phylosig(tree_site, eaf_tip, method = "lambda", test = TRUE),
      error = function(e) list(lambda = NA_real_, P = NA_real_)
    )
  }

  subtitle_txt <- paste0(
    "\nPagel’s λ = ", formatC(L_res$lambda, format = "f", digits = 3),
    " (p = ", formatC(L_res$P, format = "e", digits = 2), ")"
  )

  ## 8) node data with Phylum
  td <- treeio::as_tibble(tree_site)
  n_tips <- Ntip(tree_site)

  phy_tips <- tt.t[tree_site$tip.label, "Phylum"]
  names(phy_tips) <- tree_site$tip.label

  td$Phylum <- NA_character_
  tip_rows <- td$node <= n_tips
  td$Phylum[tip_rows] <- phy_tips[td$label[tip_rows]]

  for (node in (n_tips + 1):max(td$node)) {
    desc_idx    <- Descendants(tree_site, node, type = "tips")[[1]]
    desc_labels <- tree_site$tip.label[desc_idx]
    ph          <- unique(na.omit(phy_tips[desc_labels]))
    td$Phylum[td$node == node] <- if (length(ph) == 1L) ph else NA_character_
  }

  ## 9) EAF bar-panel data
  eaf_df <- data.frame(
    ID     = tree_site$tip.label,
    EAF    = as.numeric(eaf_mean[tree_site$tip.label]),
    logEAF = -log10(as.numeric(eaf_mean[tree_site$tip.label])),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  eaf_df <- eaf_df[is.finite(eaf_df$logEAF) & !is.na(eaf_df$ID), , drop = FALSE]

  ## 10) plot
  p <- ggtree(
      tree_site,
      layout        = "rectangular",
      ladderize     = TRUE,
      branch.length = "none",
      aes(color = Phylum)
    ) %<+% td +
    geom_tree(size = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values   = phylum_cols,
      na.value = "grey80",
      name     = "Phylum",
      guide    = if (show_legends) "legend" else "none"
    ) +
    labs(subtitle = subtitle_txt) +
    theme_tree2() +
     theme(
      plot.subtitle  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      plot.margin    = grid::unit(c(6, 8, 6, 2), "mm"),  # increase bottom margin
      axis.text.x    = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x   = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x    = element_blank()
    ) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    ggtreeExtra::geom_fruit(
      data    = eaf_df,
      geom    = geom_col,
      mapping = aes(y = ID, x = EAF, fill = EAF),
      orientation = "y",
      offset  = 0.05,   # <<< tighter tree–fruit spacing
      pwidth  = bar_pwidth,
    axis.params = axis_params(
        axis       = "x",
        text.size  = 3,
        at         = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
        vjust      = 2.2,
        hjust      = 0.5,
        text.angle = 45,
        line.size  = 0.2,
        line.color = "grey40"
      ),
      width   = bar_width
    ) +
    # scale_fill_viridis_c(
    #   name   = "Mean 15N-EAF",
    #   option = "plasma",
    #   trans  = "log10",
    #   limits = c(1e-4, 1),
    #   oob    = scales::squish,
    #   guide  = if (show_legends) "colourbar" else "none"
    # ) + 
     scale_fill_gradientn(
      name   = "Mean 15N-EAF",
      colors = c("white", "#FF69B4", "#FF1493"),
      limits = c(0, 1),
      oob    = scales::squish,
      guide  = if (show_legends) "colourbar" else "none"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

  list(
    plot = p,
    stats = data.frame(
      Site     = site_id,
      Faith_PD = faith_pd,
      lambda   = L_res$lambda,
      lambda_p = L_res$P,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}

#. same y-range for every panel = same height per tip
plots  <- list(PB = p_PB$plot, WC = p_WC$plot, MC = p_MC$plot)
n_tips <- sapply(plots, function(p) sum(p$data$isTip))
n_max  <- max(n_tips)

#. top-aligned: empty space falls below smaller trees
plots <- Map(function(p, n)
  suppressMessages(p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(n - n_max + 0.5, n + 0.5), clip = "off")),
  plots, n_tips)

plot_grid(plots$PB, plots$WC, plots$MC, ncol = 3,
          rel_widths = c(1, 1, 1.5),
          labels = c("Low Site", "Mid Site", "High Site"),
          label_size = 14)

```

## 10A. beta-disper analysis
```{r unifrac_betadisper}
library(vegan)
library(GUniFrac)

#  make df without NAs
ft.t.inc.2 <- ft.t.inc
ft.t.inc.2[is.na(ft.t.inc.2)] <- 0

# 1. Calculate UniFrac distances
unifrac_all <- GUniFrac(t(ft.t.inc.2), tree_pruned, alpha = c(0, 0.5, 1))

unifrac_un <- as.dist(unifrac_all$unifracs[,, "d_UW"])  # unweighted
unifrac_w  <- as.dist(unifrac_all$unifracs[,, "d_1"])   # weighted

# 2. PERMANOVA
meta <- inc.env.pre$Site
permanova_un <- adonis2(unifrac_un ~ meta, permutations = 999)
permanova_w  <- adonis2(unifrac_w  ~ meta, permutations = 999)

permanova_un
permanova_w

# 3. Check dispersion
disp_un <- betadisper(unifrac_un, meta)
disp_w  <- betadisper(unifrac_w,  meta)

permutest(disp_un)
permutest(disp_w)
```

## 10B. UniFrac: assimilator vs non-assimilator composition and site effect
```{r unifrac_inc_vs_ni}
library(vegan)
library(GUniFrac)
library(permute)
library(ape)

#. per-sample communities from 1A (inc.m = assimilators, ni.m = non-assimilators)
n <- length(shrubs)
comm.g <- rbind(t(inc.m), t(ni.m))
rownames(comm.g) <- c(paste0(shrubs, "_A"), paste0(shrubs, "_N"))
comm.g <- comm.g[, colnames(comm.g) %in% tree.p$tip.label, drop = FALSE]
comm.g <- comm.g[, colSums(comm.g) > 0, drop = FALSE]
tree.g <- drop.tip(tree.p, setdiff(tree.p$tip.label, colnames(comm.g)))
comm.g <- comm.g[, tree.g$tip.label]

meta.g <- data.frame(
  sample = rep(shrubs, 2),
  site   = factor(c(PB = "Low", WC = "Mid", MC = "High")[substr(rep(shrubs, 2), 1, 2)],
                  levels = c("Low", "Mid", "High")),
  group  = factor(rep(c("Assimilator", "Non-assimilator"), each = n)),
  row.names = rownames(comm.g)
)

#. 1. unweighted UniFrac (presence/absence)
uf   <- GUniFrac(comm.g, tree.g, alpha = 1)$unifracs[, , "d_UW"]
d.uw <- as.dist(uf)

#. 2. PERMANOVA, permuting group labels within each soil sample
#.    (the site row is not testable under this design; interpret group and site:group only)
set.seed(1)
perm <- how(nperm = 999, blocks = meta.g$sample)
perm.uw <- adonis2(d.uw ~ site + group + site:group, data = meta.g,
                   permutations = perm, by = "terms")
perm.uw

```
